headline: Jean Bourbeau: AI may support COPD diagnosis, remote monitoring and post-hospital care
dek: GOLD said the Science Committee member discussed AI in COPD care in a series of interviews recorded at CHEST 2026.
body:
The Global Initiative for Chronic Obstructive Lung Disease (GOLD) said on X that Jean Bourbeau, MD, MPH, a member of the GOLD Science Committee, has discussed how artificial intelligence may support COPD care.

According to the post, the discussion took place in a series of interviews at CHEST 2026. It named three areas where AI may help: COPD diagnosis, remote monitoring and posthospital care.

The post linked to the interviews, which it invited followers to listen to. It did not include details of Bourbeau's specific comments, the format of the interviews or any supporting data.
